title: Welcome V2 & Fleet Channel Indexes
summary: Rebuilds the Welcome surface as Discord Components v2 with a transparent member banner, converts Trade with Misfits into a configured-role action, hardens dashboard Discord authorization against rate limits, and adds persistent signup/roster channel landing panels and indexes.

sections.title: Welcome surface
items: The old embed is replaced with a true Components v2 container containing only the member-specific banner and action buttons.
The banner asset is tightly cropped with transparent rounded corners so Discord no longer shows a large white attachment canvas.
Buttons are now Apply to BOM, Trade with Misfits, and Diplomacy.
Trade with Misfits grants the configured Trade role instead of opening a URL.
The Welcome message is pinned, remains at the bottom of its channel, and automatically upgrades the previous legacy embed after restart.

sections.title: Port Battle Discord channels
items: The signup channel always has a pinned Port Battle Signups landing embed, even when no battles exist.
A PB Signup Index always exists and stays at the bottom of the signup channel, including an empty-state index when no signups are open.
The roster channel always has a pinned Port Battle Rosters landing embed, even when no rosters exist.
When more than one current roster exists, a Rosters Index is created at the bottom with direct links to each roster; it is removed automatically when no longer needed.

sections.title: Dashboard authorization resilience
items: Concurrent dashboard authorization checks now share in-flight Discord lookups instead of issuing duplicate guild/member/role requests.
Discord 429 responses receive a bounded retry and previously verified authorization/context can be used briefly as stale fallback instead of turning a transient rate limit into a dashboard 500.
Membership & Welcome configuration adds a Trade role selector and keeps the native Recruitment application flow as the preferred Apply to BOM action.
